entries.vietlish: I am knowing the answer
entries.natural: I know the answer
entries.sourcePattern: dang biet -> stative verb forced into the progressive
entries.context: Ask me, I am knowing the answer to this question.

entries.vietlish: she is having a car
entries.natural: she has a car
entries.sourcePattern: dang co xe -> stative have forced into the progressive
entries.context: She is having a car, so she can drive us there.

entries.vietlish: do you have finished
entries.natural: have you finished
entries.sourcePattern: ban xong chua -> do-support added to a perfect question
entries.context: Do you have finished your report for the meeting?

entries.vietlish: I need a scissor
entries.natural: I need scissors
entries.sourcePattern: cai keo -> scissors treated as singular with article
entries.context: To cut this paper I need a scissor.

entries.vietlish: give me some advice please
entries.natural: give me some advice please
entries.sourcePattern: cho toi loi khuyen -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for register check
entries.context: I don't know what to choose, give me some advice please.

entries.vietlish: she is can swim very well
entries.natural: she can swim very well
entries.sourcePattern: co the boi -> be inserted before a modal
entries.context: She is can swim very well, she trains every day.

entries.vietlish: I am must finish today
entries.natural: I must finish today
entries.sourcePattern: phai xong -> be inserted before must
entries.context: Sorry, I cannot go out, I am must finish today.

entries.vietlish: put your name in the top of the page
entries.natural: put your name at the top of the page
entries.sourcePattern: o tren cung -> in for at with top
entries.context: Please put your name in the top of the page before you start.

entries.vietlish: he succeeded to pass the exam
entries.natural: he succeeded in passing the exam
entries.sourcePattern: thanh cong vuot qua -> to-infinitive instead of in + gerund
entries.context: After studying hard, he succeeded to pass the exam.

entries.vietlish: she wears a ring on her hand
entries.natural: she wears a ring on her finger
entries.sourcePattern: deo nhan o tay -> tay = hand/arm covers finger too
entries.context: She wears a ring on her hand, maybe she is engaged.

entries.vietlish: please help me to take down the box
entries.natural: please help me get the box down
entries.sourcePattern: lay xuong giup -> take down calqued plus extra to
entries.context: The shelf is high, please help me to take down the box.

entries.vietlish: let me take a note of your number
entries.natural: let me make a note of your number
entries.sourcePattern: ghi lai -> take collocated with note instead of make
entries.context: One moment, let me take a note of your number.

entries.vietlish: we make a queue to buy ticket
entries.natural: we line up to buy tickets
entries.sourcePattern: xep hang -> make a queue plus ticket without plural
entries.context: At the cinema we make a queue to buy ticket.

entries.vietlish: I am very confident to pass
entries.natural: I'm confident I'll pass
entries.sourcePattern: tu tin se do -> to-infinitive instead of a that-clause
entries.context: I studied a lot, I am very confident to pass the exam.

entries.vietlish: she eats for two persons
entries.natural: she eats for two people
entries.sourcePattern: an cho hai nguoi -> person pluralized as persons
entries.context: She is pregnant now, she eats for two persons.

entries.vietlish: she is sensible to the cold
entries.natural: she is sensitive to the cold
entries.sourcePattern: nhay cam -> sensible borrowed for sensitive
entries.context: Bring a jacket for her, she is sensible to the cold.

entries.vietlish: my hand is paining
entries.natural: my hand hurts
entries.sourcePattern: tay dau -> pain used as a verb in the progressive
entries.context: After lifting boxes, my hand is paining a lot.

entries.vietlish: this bag is as the same as that one
entries.natural: this bag is the same as that one
entries.sourcePattern: giong nhu -> as inserted before the same
entries.context: Don't buy two, this bag is as the same as that one.

entries.vietlish: he earns double than me
entries.natural: he earns double what I earn
entries.sourcePattern: gap doi toi -> than instead of what after double
entries.context: In the new job he earns double than me.

entries.vietlish: my blood pressure is up today
entries.natural: my blood pressure is high today
entries.sourcePattern: huyet ap len -> up for high, calque of len
entries.context: I feel dizzy, my blood pressure is up today.

entries.vietlish: she fainted because too hot
entries.natural: she fainted because it was too hot
entries.sourcePattern: vi qua nong -> dummy subject and be dropped in the clause
entries.context: At the market she fainted because too hot at noon.

entries.vietlish: I want to check my health total
entries.natural: I want a full health check-up
entries.sourcePattern: kham tong quat -> total placed after noun, calque of tong quat
entries.context: Once a year I want to check my health total at the hospital.

entries.vietlish: I am free after five, call me
entries.natural: I'm free after five, call me then
entries.sourcePattern: ranh sau nam gio -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for register
entries.context: I am free after five, call me when you finish work.

entries.vietlish: she is doing thin these days
entries.natural: she is getting thinner these days
entries.sourcePattern: gay di -> do/become for get with an adjective
entries.context: She works too hard, she is doing thin these days.

entries.vietlish: she is more beautiful than before very much
entries.natural: she is much more beautiful than before
entries.sourcePattern: dep hon truoc nhieu -> intensifier placed at the end
entries.context: After the trip she is more beautiful than before very much.

entries.vietlish: the soup tastes very salty, add water
entries.natural: the soup tastes very salty, add some water
entries.sourcePattern: them nuoc -> water without a quantifier in the imperative
entries.context: The soup tastes very salty, add water to make it lighter.

entries.vietlish: he speaks English better and better
entries.natural: he speaks English better and better
entries.sourcePattern: ngay cang tot -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: After one year abroad, he speaks English better and better.

entries.vietlish: she gave birth a baby girl
entries.natural: she gave birth to a baby girl
entries.sourcePattern: sinh mot be gai -> to dropped after give birth
entries.context: Last month she gave birth a baby girl, very cute.

entries.vietlish: he is afraid that he will fail again
entries.natural: he is afraid that he will fail again
entries.sourcePattern: so rang -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: He studies all night, he is afraid that he will fail again.

entries.vietlish: the children grow up very fast
entries.natural: the children grow up very fast
entries.sourcePattern: lon nhanh -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: I haven't seen them in a year, the children grow up very fast.

entries.vietlish: the teacher made us memorize all the lesson
entries.natural: the teacher made us memorize the whole lesson
entries.sourcePattern: ca bai -> all the lesson for the whole lesson
entries.context: Before the test, the teacher made us memorize all the lesson.

entries.vietlish: she is the same height with her sister
entries.natural: she is the same height as her sister
entries.sourcePattern: cao bang -> with instead of as for same height
entries.context: People mix them up, she is the same height with her sister.

entries.vietlish: please water on the plants tonight
entries.natural: please water the plants tonight
entries.sourcePattern: tuoi cay -> on inserted plus calque of tuoi
entries.context: I will be away, please water on the plants tonight.

entries.vietlish: she cuts the apple into four part
entries.natural: she cuts the apple into four parts
entries.sourcePattern: bon phan -> part without plural after a number
entries.context: For the children, she cuts the apple into four part.

entries.vietlish: I am very thankful for your kindness
entries.natural: I'm very thankful for your kindness
entries.sourcePattern: rat biet on -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for register
entries.context: You helped me a lot, I am very thankful for your kindness.

entries.vietlish: I want to say thank to everybody
entries.natural: I want to say thanks to everybody
entries.sourcePattern: noi cam on -> thank without -s in say thanks
entries.context: Before I leave, I want to say thank to everybody here.

entries.vietlish: we will meet again in some day
entries.natural: we'll meet again someday
entries.sourcePattern: mot ngay nao do -> in + some day for someday
entries.context: Goodbye for now, we will meet again in some day.

entries.vietlish: I am studying to become a teacher in the future
entries.natural: I'm studying to become a teacher in the future
entries.sourcePattern: trong tuong lai -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: I love children, I am studying to become a teacher in the future.

entries.vietlish: the room is lacking of light
entries.natural: the room lacks light
entries.sourcePattern: thieu anh sang -> of inserted after lacking
entries.context: Open the curtain, the room is lacking of light.

entries.vietlish: he is suffering from a difficult time
entries.natural: he is going through a difficult time
entries.sourcePattern: trai qua kho khan -> suffer from for go through
entries.context: Please be gentle, he is suffering from a difficult time now.

entries.vietlish: she married early, only nineteen years old
entries.natural: she married young, at only nineteen
entries.sourcePattern: lay chong som -> early for young plus redundant years old
entries.context: In the village she married early, only nineteen years old.

entries.vietlish: we should keep the environment clean for next generation
entries.natural: we should keep the environment clean for the next generation
entries.sourcePattern: the he sau -> article dropped before next generation
entries.context: Don't litter, we should keep the environment clean for next generation.

entries.vietlish: she works as a waiter in a restaurant
entries.natural: she works as a waitress in a restaurant
entries.sourcePattern: phuc vu -> waiter used for both genders
entries.context: To pay for school, she works as a waiter in a restaurant.

entries.vietlish: I cut down the tree last weekend
entries.natural: I trimmed the tree last weekend
entries.sourcePattern: tia cay -> cut down for trim, wrong particle
entries.context: It was too tall, so I cut down the tree last weekend.

entries.vietlish: he runs a small shop near the market
entries.natural: he runs a small shop near the market
entries.sourcePattern: mo cua hang -> direct calque, acceptable but staged for review
entries.context: After he retired, he runs a small shop near the market.
